-- Keyboard and gamepad navigation for the open menu, plus the input suppression
-- that stops navigating a menu from also driving the character.
--
-- Built out of GTA V control IDs, so the whole loop is FiveM-only and every entry
-- point degrades to a no-op elsewhere. It emits protocol-free names -- 'navigate',
-- 'input', 'hidden' -- through a sender the menu client installs, so no NUI wire
-- string appears here.

MenuInput = {}
local I = MenuInput

local visible, typing, generation = false, false, 0
local modal, suppressUntilRelease = false, false
local emit = function() end

--- Installed by the menu client, so the NUI protocol can be renamed without
--- touching a control ID.
function I.bindSender(fn)
    if type(fn) == 'function' then emit = fn end
end

function I.setModal(active)
    modal = active == true
    if not modal then suppressUntilRelease = true end
end

-- Accept and back fire on release: a submenu opening under a still-held Enter
-- must not immediately activate its own first row.
local bindings = {
    { name = 'back', controls = { 177, 202 }, release = true },
    { name = 'accept', controls = { 176, 201, 106 }, release = true },
    -- 181/180 are the scroll wheel: single-frame presses, so they never feed the
    -- hold ladder, and they yield to the weapon wheel below.
    { name = 'up', controls = { 172, 188 }, wheel = { 181 }, repeatable = true },
    { name = 'down', controls = { 173, 187 }, wheel = { 180 }, repeatable = true },
    { name = 'left', controls = { 174, 189 }, repeatable = true },
    { name = 'right', controls = { 175, 190 }, repeatable = true },
}
-- 44/21/22/23/75 share a physical controller button with accept/back; letting
-- them through makes the character jump or leave a vehicle while navigating.
local blocked = { 20, 24, 25, 27, 44, 68, 69, 70, 92, 114, 140, 141, 142, 200, 257, 263, 264 }
-- Only while the player is in a vehicle.
local blockedInVehicle = { 73, 74, 80, 81, 82, 85, 99, 100, 332, 333, 357 }

-- First repeat after 200ms, then accelerating with the run length. A long vehicle
-- or weapon list is unusable at a flat rate.
local function repeatDelay(times)
    if times > 60 then return 25 elseif times > 25 then return 50
    elseif times > 5 then return 100 elseif times > 2 then return 150 end
    return 200
end

local function yes(value) return value == true or value == 1 end

-- The weapon wheel is disabled only for a gamepad sitting on a slider or list row,
-- where left/right would fight it; the browser reports the highlighted row kind.
local valueRow = false
function I.setValueRow(active) valueRow = active == true end

-- Suspension, not closure. A real close resets the browser to the main page and
-- drops every uncommitted selector and slider draft, so the pause menu or a screen
-- fade would throw away a half-dialed row. Suspending stops forwarding and
-- blocking native input and asks the browser to stand down, leaving the session,
-- page and drafts intact.
--
-- Death is not one of these: the state it was configuring no longer exists.
local suspended = false
local function suspend(active)
    if suspended == active then return end
    suspended = active
    -- Text entry holds NUI keyboard focus and the pause menu cannot be used through
    -- it. Conditional because this runs on a frame boundary -- an unconditional
    -- I.text(false) would post a message on every suspension.
    if active and typing then I.text(false) end
    emit('hidden', active)
end
function I.text(active)
    if active and (not visible or modal or (not typing and _TLIB_IS_FIVEM
        and type(IsNuiFocused) == 'function' and yes(IsNuiFocused()))) then return false end
    if typing and not active then suppressUntilRelease = true end
    local hadFocus = typing
    typing = active == true
    if _TLIB_IS_FIVEM and (typing or hadFocus) then
        SetNuiFocus(typing, false)
        SetNuiFocusKeepInput(false)
    end
    emit('input', typing)
    return true
end
function I.isTyping() return typing end

function I.setVisible(active, onClose)
    generation = generation + 1
    visible = active == true
    I.text(false)
    -- Closing while suspended must not leave the browser hidden, or the next open
    -- draws nothing.
    suspend(false)
    if not visible or not _TLIB_IS_FIVEM then return end
    local current, repeats = generation, {}
    Platform.createThread(function()
        while visible and current == generation do
            if yes(IsEntityDead(PlayerPedId())) then onClose(); break end
            -- A fade means the game is showing the player something else, and no
            -- fade covers the browser's panel. Probed rather than called outright,
            -- like every other optional native here.
            local faded = type(IsScreenFadedOut) == 'function' and yes(IsScreenFadedOut())
            suspend(yes(IsPauseMenuActive()) or faded)
            -- Dialogs and other resources' NUI own their keyboard while focused;
            -- their closing key release is not a menu action.
            local nuiFocused = type(IsNuiFocused) == 'function' and yes(IsNuiFocused())
            if nuiFocused then suppressUntilRelease = true end
            if not suspended and not typing and not modal and not nuiFocused then
                local ped = PlayerPedId()
                local inVehicle = yes(IsPedInAnyVehicle(ped, false))
                local gamepad = not yes(IsInputDisabled(2))
                -- Holding the weapon-select key hands the wheel back to weapon
                -- switching and the menu ignores it.
                local weaponWheel = yes(IsControlPressed(0, 37)) or yes(IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 37))
                for _, control in ipairs(blocked) do DisableControlAction(0, control, true) end
                if inVehicle then
                    for _, control in ipairs(blockedInVehicle) do DisableControlAction(0, control, true) end
                end
                if not weaponWheel then
                    DisableControlAction(0, 16, true); DisableControlAction(0, 17, true)
                end
                if gamepad and valueRow then DisableControlAction(0, 37, true) end
                for _, binding in ipairs(bindings) do
                    for _, control in ipairs(binding.controls) do DisableControlAction(0, control, true) end
                    if binding.wheel and not weaponWheel then
                        for _, control in ipairs(binding.wheel) do DisableControlAction(0, control, true) end
                    end
                end
                -- Controller accept/back must not also jump, sprint or enter a vehicle.
                if gamepad then
                    for _, control in ipairs({ 21, 22, 23, 75 }) do DisableControlAction(0, control, true) end
                end
                -- Suppression lifts on the same frame the held key is released, and
                -- accept/back fire on that edge. Skip the frame or dismissing a
                -- prompt immediately re-activates a row.
                local justLifted = false
                if suppressUntilRelease then
                    local held = false
                    for _, binding in ipairs(bindings) do
                        for _, control in ipairs(binding.controls) do held = held or yes(IsDisabledControlPressed(0, control)) end
                    end
                    if not held then suppressUntilRelease = false; repeats = {}; justLifted = true end
                end
                local now = Platform.now()
                for _, binding in ipairs(bindings) do
                    if suppressUntilRelease or justLifted then break end
                    local pressed, held = false, false
                    for _, control in ipairs(binding.controls) do
                        if binding.release then pressed = pressed or yes(IsDisabledControlJustReleased(0, control))
                        else pressed = pressed or yes(IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, control)) end
                        held = held or yes(IsDisabledControlPressed(0, control))
                    end
                    -- A wheel notch is a one-frame press with no hold: it moves the
                    -- row once and never enters the ladder below.
                    if binding.wheel and not weaponWheel then
                        for _, control in ipairs(binding.wheel) do
                            pressed = pressed or yes(IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, control))
                        end
                    end
                    local state = repeats[binding.name]
                    local fire = pressed
                    if pressed then repeats[binding.name] = { due = now + 200, times = 0 }
                    elseif binding.repeatable and held then
                        if state and now >= state.due then
                            fire = true
                            state.times = state.times + 1
                            state.due = now + repeatDelay(state.times)
                        elseif not state then repeats[binding.name] = { due = now + 200, times = 0 } end
                    elseif not held then repeats[binding.name] = nil end
                    if fire then emit('navigate', binding.name); break end
                end
            end
            Platform.wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

--- Bind the search key. The command name comes from whoever configures the
--- interface, since it sits alongside that resource's own open command in the
--- player's keybind list.
function I.bindSearchKey(command, key, label)
    if not _TLIB_IS_FIVEM or type(command) ~= 'string' or command == '' then return false end
    RegisterCommand(command, function()
        if visible then I.text(not typing) end
    end, false)
    RegisterKeyMapping(command, label or 'Search the open menu', 'keyboard', key or 'F3')
    return true
end

function I.cleanup() I.setVisible(false) end

return MenuInput

-- Asking the player to type something without handing the browser the keyboard.
-- The menu draws and the game keeps the input; NUI focus for a text field would
-- put a mouse cursor over a controller-navigated menu and swallow movement keys
-- while the field was open. GTA's onscreen keyboard -- what the pause menu uses --
-- avoids both. One prompt for the whole interface, since there is one screen.

if _TLIB_SIDE ~= 'client' then return end

MenuPrompt = {}
local P = MenuPrompt

-- Registered at call time with the caller's title. Arbitrary but global to the
-- game session, hence the prefix.
local TEXT_ENTRY = 'TLIB_MENU_INPUT'

local prompting = false

--- Always safe to call: cancels whatever is open and returns the menu to ordinary
--- navigation. The client engine calls it on close and on shutdown.
function P.release()
    if prompting and type(CancelOnscreenKeyboard) == 'function' then pcall(CancelOnscreenKeyboard) end
    prompting = false
    if MenuInput then MenuInput.setModal(false) end
end

function P.active() return prompting end

--- Ask for a line of text. Blocks the calling thread until the player commits or
--- cancels, so call it from an action handler and never from the presentation path.
---
--- Returns the string on commit and nil on cancel. Everything else -- a second
--- concurrent prompt, an action cancelled underneath it, a timeout -- is raised
--- with error(message, 0), the shape the dispatcher reports to the player rather
--- than logging as a crash.
function P.text(title, initial, maximum, context)
    assert(MenuSchema.text(title, 128), 'Invalid input title')
    assert(type(maximum) == 'number' and maximum % 1 == 0 and maximum >= 1 and maximum <= 128, 'Invalid input length')
    assert(type(initial) == 'string' and #initial <= maximum and not initial:find('%c'), 'Invalid initial input')
    if not _TLIB_IS_FIVEM then error('Text input is unavailable on this platform', 0) end
    if prompting then error('Another input is already active', 0) end
    local function active() return context and context.isActive and context.isActive() end
    if not active() then error('Action cancelled', 0) end
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        prompting = true
        if MenuInput then MenuInput.text(false); MenuInput.setModal(true) end
        AddTextEntry(TEXT_ENTRY, title)
        DisplayOnscreenKeyboard(1, TEXT_ENTRY, '', initial, '', '', '', maximum)
        -- Two deadlines: the wall clock catches a player who walked away, the
        -- frame count catches a paused or hitching game, where the wall clock
        -- would expire without the keyboard ever being polled.
        local started, frames = Platform.now(), 0
        while prompting and active() do
            local state = UpdateOnscreenKeyboard()
            if state == 1 then
                local value = GetOnscreenKeyboardResult()
                if type(value) ~= 'string' or #value > maximum or value:find('%c') then error('Invalid input text', 0) end
                return value
            end
            if state == 2 or state == 3 then return nil end
            frames = frames + 1
            if Platform.now() - started >= 60000 or frames >= 36000 then error('Text input timed out', 0) end
            Platform.wait(0)
        end
        error('Action cancelled', 0)
    end)
    P.release()
    if not ok then error(result, 0) end
    -- The action may have been cancelled while the player typed; committing into a
    -- dead action is worse than losing the text.
    if not active() then error('Action cancelled', 0) end
    return result
end

return MenuPrompt

-- Lua mirrors the theme registry, so it can validate and answer reads without a
-- UI round trip.

ThemeExports  = {}

local log     = Logger.create('tLib/theme')

local ui      = nil
local _themes = {}

local function assertUI(fname)
    if not ui then
        log(fname .. ': Theme subsystem not initialised (ui is nil)', 4)
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local function assertId(fname, id)
    if type(id) ~= 'string' or id == '' then
        log(fname .. ': id must be a non-empty string', 3)
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local function shallowCopy(t)
    if type(t) ~= 'table' then return t end
    local copy = {}
    for k, v in pairs(t) do copy[k] = v end
    return copy
end

function ThemeExports.register(webui)
    ui = webui

    local function registerExport(name, fn)
        Platform.export('tLib', name, fn)
    end

    -- Register a theme, or replace one with the same id.
    --
    --   opts.cssVars  name -> value, WITHOUT the leading "--":
    --                 { primary = "262 83% 58%", radius = "0.75rem" }
    --   opts.extends  id of a registered theme to inherit from; these cssVars
    --                 overlay its own
    --   opts.font     font-family, sets --font-sans
    --   opts.fontSize percentage, sets the html font-size
    registerExport('AddTheme', function(id, opts)
        if not assertUI('AddTheme') then return false end
        if not assertId('AddTheme', id) then return false end
        if type(opts) ~= 'table' then
            log('AddTheme: opts must be a table', 3)
            return false
        end

        local def = {
            id          = id,
            name        = type(opts.name) == 'string' and opts.name ~= '' and opts.name or id,
            description = type(opts.description) == 'string' and opts.description or nil,
            extends     = type(opts.extends) == 'string' and opts.extends ~= '' and opts.extends or nil,
            font        = type(opts.font) == 'string' and opts.font ~= '' and opts.font or nil,
            fontSize    = type(opts.fontSize) == 'string' and opts.fontSize ~= '' and opts.fontSize or nil,
        }

        -- cssVars must be a flat string -> string map.
        if type(opts.cssVars) == 'table' then
            local vars = {}
            for k, v in pairs(opts.cssVars) do
                if type(k) == 'string' and type(v) == 'string' then
                    vars[k] = v
                else
                    log('AddTheme: cssVars entry "' .. tostring(k) .. '" skipped (key and value must both be strings)', 3)
                end
            end
            def.cssVars = vars
        end

        _themes[id] = def
        Platform.sendUIEvent(ui, 'addTheme', def)

        Platform.TriggerEvent('tLib:theme:added', id)
        return true
    end)

    -- Removing the active theme clears the :root override; store.ts handles that.
    registerExport('RemoveTheme', function(id)
        if not assertUI('RemoveTheme') then return false end
        if not assertId('RemoveTheme', id) then return false end

        if not _themes[id] then
            log('RemoveTheme: theme "' .. id .. '" is not registered', 3)
            return false
        end

        _themes[id] = nil
        Platform.sendUIEvent(ui, 'removeTheme', { id = id })
        Platform.TriggerEvent('tLib:theme:removed', id)
        return true
    end)

    -- Applies the theme's vars to :root, so every component without a theme of
    -- its own inherits them. An empty id reverts to the base vars in global.css.
    registerExport('SetTheme', function(id)
        if not assertUI('SetTheme') then return false end

        if id == '' then
            Platform.sendUIEvent(ui, 'setTheme', { id = '' })
            Platform.TriggerEvent('tLib:theme:set', '')
            return true
        end

        if not assertId('SetTheme', id) then return false end

        if not _themes[id] then
            log('SetTheme: theme "' .. id .. '" is not registered — call AddTheme first', 3)
            return false
        end

        Platform.sendUIEvent(ui, 'setTheme', { id = id })
        Platform.TriggerEvent('tLib:theme:set', id)
        return true
    end)

    registerExport('GetThemes', function()
        local copy = {}
        for id, def in pairs(_themes) do
            copy[id] = shallowCopy(def)
            -- cssVars is nested; copy it too, or callers can mutate the registry.
            if type(def.cssVars) == 'table' then
                copy[id].cssVars = shallowCopy(def.cssVars)
            end
        end
        return copy
    end)

    registerExport('GetTheme', function(id)
        if not assertId('GetTheme', id) then return nil end
        local def = _themes[id]
        if not def then return nil end
        local copy = shallowCopy(def)
        if type(def.cssVars) == 'table' then
            copy.cssVars = shallowCopy(def.cssVars)
        end
        return copy
    end)
end

ToastExports = {}
local log = Logger.create('tLib/toast')
local ui, stopped = nil, false
local entries, idCounter = {}, 0
local durations = { success = 4000, error = 6000, warning = 5000, info = 4000, loading = 0 }
local MAX_PER_OWNER, MAX_TOTAL = 32, 256

local function caller()
    local owner = Platform.getInvokingResource()
    if type(owner) == 'string' and owner ~= '' then return owner end
    log('Toast export requires an invoking resource', 3)
end

local function wireId(owner, id)
    return tostring(#owner) .. ':' .. owner .. ':' .. id
end

local function validDuration(value)
    return type(value) == 'number' and value >= 0 and value <= 2147483647
end

-- The short spellings are mapped, not refused: `durations` above is the whole
-- type vocabulary, and `warn` is not in it. Three resources independently
-- passed it for the same notice anyway, each falling through to neutral
-- `info` where it meant amber `warning` — the fallback is correct for a
-- genuinely unknown type, nothing failed loudly.
--
-- `warn`/`warning` and `err`/`error` are the two pairs any Lua author reaches
-- for interchangeably (`warn` is a global in several runtimes, `err` the
-- idiomatic second-return name), so mapping them closes the class rather than
-- patching each instance.
--
-- The log stays for anything else: silently rendering an unknown type as info
-- is what hid these three for as long as it did.
local ALIASES = { warn = 'warning', err = 'error' }

local function resolveType(value)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then
        log('Unknown toast type, defaulting to info', 3)
        return 'info'
    end
    if durations[value] ~= nil then return value end
    local aliased = ALIASES[value]
    if aliased and durations[aliased] ~= nil then return aliased end
    log('Unknown toast type, defaulting to info', 3)
    return 'info'
end

local function remove(key, notify)
    local entry = entries[key]
    if not entry then return false end
    entries[key] = nil
    if entry.timer then Platform.clearTimeout(entry.timer) end
    if notify and ui then Platform.sendUIEvent(ui, 'dismissToast', { id = key }) end
    return true
end

local function schedule(key, entry, duration)
    if entry.timer then Platform.clearTimeout(entry.timer) end
    entry.timer = nil
    -- Fence timers as well as entries: a type/duration update reuses the entry.
    entry.revision = entry.revision + 1
    local revision = entry.revision
    local delay = duration and duration > 0 and duration or durations[entry.type]
    if delay > 0 then
        entry.timer = Platform.setTimeout(function()
            if entries[key] == entry and entry.revision == revision then remove(key, true) end
        end, delay)
    end
end

local function owned(id)
    if stopped or not ui or type(id) ~= 'string' or id == '' then return end
    local owner = caller()
    if not owner then return end
    local key = wireId(owner, id)
    return entries[key], key
end

function ToastExports.register(webui)
    ui = webui

    -- IDs are local to the producer. Return values and public events keep that
    -- local ID; the renderer sees a namespaced ID so producers cannot collide.
    Platform.export('tLib', 'ShowToast', function(id, toastType, title, description, duration, theme)
        if stopped or not ui then return nil end
        local owner = caller()
        if not owner then return nil end
        if type(id) ~= 'string' or id == '' then
            repeat
                idCounter = idCounter + 1
                id = 'tlib_toast_' .. tostring(idCounter)
            until not entries[wireId(owner, id)]
        end
        local key = wireId(owner, id)
        if not entries[key] then
            local total, ownerCount = 0, 0
            for _, entry in pairs(entries) do
                total = total + 1
                if entry.owner == owner then ownerCount = ownerCount + 1 end
            end
            if total >= MAX_TOTAL or ownerCount >= MAX_PER_OWNER then
                return nil, 'Too many active toasts'
            end
        end
        remove(key, false)
        toastType = resolveType(toastType)
        local entry = { owner = owner, id = id, type = toastType, revision = 0 }
        entries[key] = entry
        duration = validDuration(duration) and duration or nil
        title = type(title) == 'string' and title or ''
        Platform.sendUIEvent(ui, 'showToast', {
            id = key, type = toastType, title = title,
            description = type(description) == 'string' and description or nil,
            duration = duration,
            theme = type(theme) == 'string' and theme ~= '' and theme or nil,
        })
        schedule(key, entry, duration)
        Platform.TriggerEvent('tLib:toast:shown', id, toastType, title, owner)
        return id
    end)

    -- Text/theme-only patches retain their deadline. Type changes and explicit
    -- durations restart it; duration=0 restores the current type's default.
    Platform.export('tLib', 'UpdateToast', function(id, changes)
        local entry, key = owned(id)
        if not entry or type(changes) ~= 'table' then return false end
        local patch = {}
        if type(changes.type) == 'string' then patch.type = resolveType(changes.type) end
        if type(changes.title) == 'string' then patch.title = changes.title end
        if type(changes.description) == 'string' then patch.description = changes.description end
        if type(changes.theme) == 'string' then patch.theme = changes.theme end
        if validDuration(changes.duration) then patch.duration = changes.duration end
        if next(patch) == nil then return false end
        if patch.type then entry.type = patch.type end
        if patch.type or patch.duration ~= nil then schedule(key, entry, patch.duration) end
        Platform.sendUIEvent(ui, 'updateToast', { id = key, changes = patch })
        Platform.TriggerEvent('tLib:toast:updated', id, patch, entry.owner)
        return true
    end)

    Platform.export('tLib', 'DismissToast', function(id)
        local entry, key = owned(id)
        if not entry then return false end
        remove(key, true)
        Platform.TriggerEvent('tLib:toast:dismissed', id, entry.owner)
        return true
    end)

    -- Public bulk dismissal is producer-scoped, never a global UI reset.
    Platform.export('tLib', 'DismissAll', function()
        if stopped or not ui then return false end
        local owner = caller()
        if not owner then return false end
        for key, entry in pairs(entries) do
            if entry.owner == owner then remove(key, true) end
        end
        Platform.TriggerEvent('tLib:toast:dismissedAll', owner)
        return true
    end)
end

AddEventHandler('onClientResourceStop', function(owner)
    for key, entry in pairs(entries) do
        if entry.owner == owner then remove(key, true) end
    end
end)

Platform.onShutdown(function()
    stopped = true
    for key in pairs(entries) do remove(key, false) end
    if ui then Platform.sendUIEvent(ui, 'dismissAllToasts', {}) end
    ui = nil
end)

fx_version 'cerulean'
game 'gta5'
lua54 'yes'

name 'tLib'
author 'Tommy Johnston'
author 'TIMMYG Studios'
description 'tLib — shared UI and utility library (FiveM)'

version '1.2'

-- Don't move imports.lua: consumers name '@tLib/imports.lua' in their own
-- manifests, so the path is a contract.

shared_scripts {
    'shared/lib/adapter/init.lua',
    'shared/lib/logger.lua',
    'shared/lib/adapter/shim.lua',
    'shared/lib/adapter/core.lua',
    'shared/lib/adapter/events.lua',
    'shared/lib/adapter/ui.lua',
    'shared/lib/adapter/shutdown.lua',
    -- Before lifecycle.lua. Consumers load this exact file too.
    'shared/sh_branding.lua',
    -- The only definition of the studio API host. Consumers load it too.
    'shared/sh_api.lua',
    'shared/lib/adapter/lifecycle.lua',
    'shared/sh_utils.lua',
    'shared/sh_coords.lua',
    -- The menu protocol. Consumers validate against this exact file.
    'shared/lib/menu/schema.lua',
    -- Signatures must match byte for byte, so consumers run this file too.
    'shared/lib/menu/catalog.lua',
}

client_scripts {
    'client/lib/adapter/player.lua',
    'client/lib/adapter/vehicle.lua',
    'client/lib/adapter/world.lua',
    'client/cl_permission.lua',
    'client/lib/theme/exports.lua',
    'client/cl_theme.lua',
    -- Before cl_menu.lua, which hands it the resolver and publisher.
    'client/lib/menu/actions.lua',
    -- Always loaded: the menu client calls these, and they no-op if unused.
    'client/lib/menu/input.lua',
    -- After actions.lua: context walks every dispatcher on each pass.
    'client/lib/menu/context.lua',
    'client/lib/menu/prompts.lua',
    -- Last of the menu engine. Before cl_main.lua, which gives it the UI handle.
    'client/cl_menu.lua',
    'client/lib/toast/exports.lua',
    'client/cl_toast.lua',
    'client/cl_ui_effects.lua',
    'client/lib/dialog/state.lua',
    'client/lib/dialog/exports.lua',
    'client/cl_dialog.lua',
    'client/lib/layout/schema.lua',
    'client/cl_layout.lua',
    'client/cl_marketplace.lua',
    -- Before cl_main.lua, so ReportKeybind exists before consumers bind keys.
    'client/cl_keybinds.lua',
    'client/cl_main.lua',
}

server_scripts {
    'server/dist/bundle.js',
    -- Right after the bundle, whose absence or damage it exists to report.
    'server/sv_install.lua',
    'server/lib/adapter/utils.lua',
    'server/lib/adapter/permission.lua',
    -- Before sv_permission and sv_marketplace: in demo mode it overrides both.
    'server/sv_demo.lua',
    'server/sv_discovery.lua',
    -- The hub on the FiveM server port. After bundle.js, whose bridge exports the
    -- routing decision it asks for; a request before that is answered 503.
    'server/sv_http_ingress.lua',
    'server/sv_permission.lua',
    -- Server-only authority state. Before sv_menu.lua, which instantiates it.
    'server/lib/menu/registry.lua',
    -- Before sv_menu.lua, which dispatches `kind = 'feedback'` into it.
    'server/sv_feedback.lua',
    'server/sv_menu.lua',
    'server/sv_serversettings.lua',
    'server/sv_marketplace.lua',
    'server/sv_community_configs.lua',
    -- After sv_demo.lua, before sv_main.lua's boot handshake.
    'server/sv_telemetry.lua',
    'server/sv_main.lua',
}

files {
    'imports.lua',
    -- These two are read by consumers via LoadResourceFile.
    'shared/sh_branding.lua',
    'shared/sh_api.lua',
    'shared/imports/**/*.lua',
    'client/ui/index.html',
    'client/ui/assets/**/*',
}

ui_page 'client/ui/index.html'

--[[
    The consumer entry point: `shared_scripts { '@tLib/imports.lua' }`.
    Modules lazy-load on first access of `tlib.<name>`.
    Design notes: docs/internal/imports-entrypoint.md
]]

local resourceName = GetCurrentResourceName()
local tLibName = 'tLib'

if resourceName == tLibName then return end

if GetResourceState(tLibName) ~= 'started' then
    error('^1tLib must be started before this resource.^0', 0)
end

local context = IsDuplicityVersion() and 'server' or 'client'

-- The release page, not the file: it is where "Source code" and tLib.zip sit side by side,
-- and picking the wrong one is the most common way to end up here.
local TLIB_RELEASES_URL = 'https://github.com/tommy141x/tLib/releases/latest'

-- Enforce tlib_min_version *before* anything touches tlib, so an outdated tLib
-- says "update tLib" instead of "No such export X". Duplicated from
-- versioncheck/server.lua: this file runs in consumer VMs, that one in tLib's.
local function parseVer(s)
    if not s then return { 0, 0, 0 } end
    s = s:gsub('^v', '')
    local parts = {}
    for n in s:gmatch('%d+') do parts[#parts + 1] = tonumber(n) end
    while #parts < 3 do parts[#parts + 1] = 0 end
    return parts
end

local requiredVersion = GetResourceMetadata(resourceName, 'tlib_min_version', 0)
if requiredVersion and requiredVersion ~= '' then
    local tlibVersion = GetResourceMetadata(tLibName, 'version', 0) or '0.0.0'
    local req, cur = parseVer(requiredVersion), parseVer(tlibVersion)
    local outdated = false
    for i = 1, 3 do
        if cur[i] < req[i] then outdated = true; break
        elseif cur[i] > req[i] then break end
    end
    if outdated then
        local build = GetResourceMetadata(tLibName, 'tlib_build', 0)
        local have = build and build ~= ''
            and ('tLib %s (build %s)'):format(tlibVersion, build)
            or ('tLib %s'):format(tlibVersion)
        if context == 'client' then
            error(('\n^1[%s] needs tLib %s or newer; this server has %s. Download tLib.zip (not '
                .. '"Source code") from %s^0'):format(resourceName, requiredVersion, have, TLIB_RELEASES_URL), 0)
        end
        -- Boxed and then stopped. An error() here aborts only this shared_script, the
        -- resource starts without `tlib`, and what scrolls past is a second, unrelated
        -- failure that names no version.
        local rule = ('^1[%s] %s^0'):format(resourceName, ('-'):rep(60))
        print(rule)
        print(('^1[%s] needs tLib %s or newer; this server has %s.^0')
            :format(resourceName, requiredVersion, have))
        print(('^1[%s] Download tLib.zip (not "Source code") from:^0'):format(resourceName))
        print(('^1[%s]   %s^0'):format(resourceName, TLIB_RELEASES_URL))
        print(('^1[%s] Replace the whole tLib folder (extract it on the server or upload by '
            .. 'SFTP), then restart the server. %s has been stopped.^0'):format(resourceName, resourceName))
        print(rule)
        StopResource(resourceName)
        error(('%s needs tLib %s or newer'):format(resourceName, requiredVersion), 0)
    end
end

--- The ONE file implementing `name` in this VM, as source plus its path, or nil.
--- `<context>.lua` wins and `shared.lua` is the fallback; they are never
--- concatenated, so a module is context-specific or context-agnostic, not both.
--- Reads files rather than the module cache, so it is also `has`'s honest answer.
local function moduleSource(name)
    if type(name) ~= 'string' or name == '' then return nil end

    local base = 'shared/imports/' .. name .. '/'
    local path = base .. context .. '.lua'
    local source = LoadResourceFile(tLibName, path)

    if not source then
        path = base .. 'shared.lua'
        source = LoadResourceFile(tLibName, path)
    end

    if not source then return nil end
    return source, path
end

local function loadModule(self, name)
    local source, path = moduleSource(name)
    if not source then return nil end

    local body, syntaxError = load(source, '@@tLib/' .. path)
    if not body then
        error(('\n^1tLib module %s will not compile: %s^0'):format(path, syntaxError), 2)
    end

    -- `or true`: a module whose wiring IS its file scope has nothing to return
    -- (shared/imports/hud/client.lua), and caching nil would send the next
    -- access to the export proxy below instead.
    local loaded = body() or true
    self[name] = loaded
    return loaded
end

local function resolve(self, name)
    local module = loadModule(self, name)
    if module then return module end

    -- Not an import module, so treat the name as a tLib export. Cached, so the
    -- metatable answers for a given name exactly once.
    local function forward(...)
        return exports[tLibName][name](nil, ...)
    end

    self[name] = forward
    return forward
end

local tlib = setmetatable({
    name = tLibName,
    context = context,
    resource = resourceName,
    -- `tlib.<anything>` is never falsy -- an unknown name resolves to the
    -- forwarding function above -- so `if tlib.diag then` is not a guard. This
    -- is, and it never runs the module body.
    has = function(name) return moduleSource(name) ~= nil end,
}, { __index = resolve })

_ENV.tlib = tlib

--- Modules whose LOADING IS THEIR WIRING, loaded by tLib itself: their file
--- scope registers the handler, and a consumer may have no Lua call to trigger
--- the lazy load. `studioOnly` is a default, not a permission.
local AUTOLOAD = {
    { name = 'occupancy' },
    { name = 'telemetry', studioOnly = true },
}

--- Does this consumer's manifest credit the studio? Loaded by path into a
--- private env, because sh_branding.lua assigns a global `StudioBranding`.
local isStudio
local function studioResource()
    if isStudio ~= nil then return isStudio end
    isStudio = false
    -- An authorless manifest cannot be the studio, and answering from metadata
    -- avoids compiling sh_branding.lua into every third-party consumer's VM.
    if GetNumResourceMetadata(resourceName, 'author') == 0
        and GetNumResourceMetadata(resourceName, 'authors') == 0 then
        return false
    end
    local chunk = LoadResourceFile(tLibName, 'shared/sh_branding.lua')
    if chunk then
        local fn = load(chunk, '@@tLib/shared/sh_branding.lua', 't',
            setmetatable({}, { __index = _ENV }))
        local ok, branding = pcall(fn)
        if ok and type(branding) == 'table' then
            isStudio = branding.isStudioResource(resourceName) == true
        end
    end
    return isStudio
end

--- Can this VM read tLib's files AT ALL? The discriminator between "one module
--- is missing" and "I cannot read tLib", which have different fixes. Asked only
--- after a module has already failed.
local function tlibReadable()
    return LoadResourceFile(tLibName, 'fxmanifest.lua') ~= nil
end

for _, entry in ipairs(AUTOLOAD) do
    if (not entry.studioOnly or studioResource()) and not rawget(tlib, entry.name) then
        -- These names are tLib's own, so one that resolves to no file is a tLib
        -- packaging bug rather than a consumer typo.
        if not loadModule(tlib, entry.name) and tlibReadable() then
            -- A print, not error(): this is a shared_script in every consumer,
            -- so raising here stops every t* resource on the server at once.
            print(('^1[tLib] cannot load its own module "%s" — no '
                .. 'shared/imports/%s/%s.lua and no shared.lua. tLib v%s is packaged '
                .. 'wrong; %s is running WITHOUT it.^0')
                :format(entry.name, entry.name, context,
                    GetResourceMetadata(tLibName, 'version', 0) or '?', resourceName))
        end
    end
end

-- Eagerly load modules the consumer's manifest declares:
--   tlib_module { 'coords' }   /   tlib_modules { 'coords', 'kvp' }
--
-- Load-bearing only for `realtime`, which tLib's server bundle reads off the
-- manifest to decide whether to install the realtime hub. Otherwise an auditable
-- parts list.
for _, key in ipairs({ 'tlib_module', 'tlib_modules' }) do
    local declared = GetNumResourceMetadata(resourceName, key)
    for index = 0, declared - 1 do
        local name = GetResourceMetadata(resourceName, key, index)
        if name and not rawget(tlib, name) then
            loadModule(tlib, name)
        end
    end
end

-- Platform permission adapter for arbitrary keys, not just tlib.admin. Server-only.
-- Resolves to ACE or a registered framework resolver.

if _TLIB_SIDE ~= 'server' then return end

local log = Logger.create('tLib/adapter/permission')

-- Server-admin override: fn(source:int, key:string) -> bool. Takes priority over
-- ACE even on FiveM, so servers mixing ACE and framework jobs can layer logic.
local _resolver = nil

function Platform.registerPermissionResolver(fn)
    if type(fn) ~= 'function' then
        error('Platform.registerPermissionResolver expects a function', 2)
    end
    _resolver = fn
end

-- demoActive/resolver are passed in so a batch samples them ONCE for the whole
-- list, not per key -- otherwise a demo toggle or resolver registration mid-list
-- could answer half the keys under one rule and half under another.
local function decidePermission(source, key, demoActive, resolver)
    -- Demo grants every key ahead of the resolver and ACE, so a framework denial
    -- can't hide the job-gated features demo mode exists to show. `Demo` is set by
    -- sv_demo.lua, which loads after this file -- fine, since it's read at call time.
    if demoActive then return true end
    if resolver then
        local ok, allowed = pcall(resolver, source, key)
        if not ok then
            -- WARN: a throwing resolver denies the key with no other sign why; fix is in the framework bridge.
            log(('resolver errored for key %q: %s'):format(key, tostring(allowed)), 3)
            return false
        end
        return allowed == true
    end
    if _TLIB_IS_FIVEM then
        -- IsPlayerAceAllowed is declared BOOL but a numeric 1 is a legal marshalling;
        -- `== true` alone would miss a 1-grant, plain truthiness would admit a 0-denial.
        local result = IsPlayerAceAllowed(tostring(source), key)
        return result == true or result == 1
    end
    return false
end

--- Check whether a player has a given permission key.
---   FiveM (no resolver)   — IsPlayerAceAllowed(source, key)
---   FiveM (with resolver) — resolver(source, key)  (ACE bypassed)
function Platform.hasPermission(source, key)
    if not source or not key then return false end
    return decidePermission(source, key, Demo and Demo.active(), _resolver)
end

--- Batch form of Platform.hasPermission: resolves a whole key list in one call,
--- since the caller's cost is the cross-resource export round trip, not the
--- decision -- tRadio's resolveAcePermissions asks 40+ keys per cache miss per
--- player, ~5ms as separate reference calls.
---
--- Same per-key logic as hasPermission (demo short-circuit, resolver priority,
--- BOOL 1/true normalisation). Fails closed: no source or non-table `keys` ->
--- empty map (every lookup nil/falsy); duplicate keys decided once; a non-string
--- or empty key gets no map entry (nil on read); a resolver error denies only
--- that key, the rest of the list is still answered.
---
--- @param source number|string
--- @param keys string[]
--- @return table<string, boolean>
function Platform.hasPermissionBatch(source, keys)
    local out = {}
    if not source or type(keys) ~= 'table' then return out end
    local demoActive = Demo and Demo.active()
    local resolver = _resolver
    for i = 1, #keys do
        local key = keys[i]
        if type(key) == 'string' and key ~= '' and out[key] == nil then
            out[key] = decidePermission(source, key, demoActive, resolver)
        end
    end
    return out
end

Platform.export('tLib', 'HasPermission', function(source, key)
    return Platform.hasPermission(source, key)
end)

-- shared/imports/permission/server.lua's `hasBatch` fails closed if this export
-- does not answer.
Platform.export('tLib', 'HasPermissionBatch', function(source, keys)
    return Platform.hasPermissionBatch(source, keys)
end)

Platform.export('tLib', 'RegisterPermissionResolver', function(fn)
    Platform.registerPermissionResolver(fn)
end)

local GARAGE = 'my_garage'

AddEventHandler('myserver:givecar', function(data, done)
  if data.player == nil or data.player.source == nil then
    return done(false, 'They need to be online')
  end
  if GetResourceState(GARAGE) ~= 'started' then
    return done(false, GARAGE .. ' is not running')

local deathHashTable = IS_FIVEM and fivemDeathHashTable or redmDeathHashTable

local function processDeath(ped)
    local killerPed = GetPedSourceOfDeath(ped)
    local causeHash = GetPedCauseOfDeath(ped)
    local killer = false
    debugPrint(("Death cause: %s / 0x%x"):format(causeHash, causeHash))

    if killerPed == ped then
        killer = false
    else
        if IsEntityAPed(killerPed) and IsPedAPlayer(killerPed) then
            killer = NetworkGetPlayerIndexFromPed(killerPed)
        elseif IsEntityAVehicle(killerPed) then
            local drivingPed = GetPedInVehicleSeat(killerPed, -1)
            if IsEntityAPed(drivingPed) == 1 and IsPedAPlayer(drivingPed) then
                killer = NetworkGetPlayerIndexFromPed(drivingPed)
            end
        end
    end

    local deathReason = deathHashTable[causeHash] or 'unknown'

    if not killer then
        if deathReason ~= "unknown" then
            deathReason = "suicide (" .. deathReason .. ")"
        else
            deathReason = "suicide"
        end
    else
        killer = GetPlayerServerId(killer)
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('txsv:logger:deathEvent', killer, deathReason)
end

-- Trigger Event From External Script
-- NOTE: couldn't people just call the txsv:logger:deathEvent event???
RegisterNetEvent('txAdmin:beta:deathLog')
AddEventHandler('txAdmin:beta:deathLog', function(ped)
	processDeath(ped) -- Remember to add a wait function before reviving into an animation.
end)

--[[ Thread ]]--
local deathFlag = false
local IsEntityDead = IsEntityDead
CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(500)
        local ped = PlayerPedId()
        local isDead = IsEntityDead(ped)
        if isDead and not deathFlag then
            deathFlag = true
            processDeath(ped)
        elseif not isDead then
            deathFlag = false
        end
    end
end)

    end,

end

-- =============================================
--  Helper to protect the NUI callbacks from CSRF attacks
--  NOTE: This is a temporary fix for the NUI callback Origin issue
-- =============================================
--- Check if a NUI callback is from the correct Origin
--- technically no request should come from nui://monitor, since the manifest version is cerulean
---@param headers table
---@return boolean
function IsNuiRequestOriginValid(headers)
    if type(headers) ~= 'table' then
        return false --no clue
    end
    if headers['Origin'] == nil then
        return true --probably legacy page
    end
    if type(headers['Origin']) ~= 'string' or headers['Origin'] == '' then
        return false --no clue
    end

    if headers['Origin'] == 'https://cfx-nui-monitor' then
        return true --probably self
    end
    if headers['Origin'] == 'https://monitor' then
        return true --probably legacy iframe inside web iframe
    end

    -- warn admin of possible csrf attempt
    if menuIsAccessible and sendPersistentAlert then
        local msg = ('ATTENTION! txAdmin received a NUI message from the origin "%s" which is not approved. This likely means that that resource is vulnerable to XSS which has been exploited to inject txAdmin commands. It is recommended that you fix the vulnerability or remove that resource completely. For more information: discord.gg/txAdmin.'):format(headers['Origin'])
        sendPersistentAlert('csrfWarning', 'error', msg, false)
    end

    return false
end

--- Wrapper for RegisterRawNuiCallback which mimics the behavior of RegisterNUICallback
--- but checks the origin of the request to prevent CSRF attacks
function RegisterSecureNuiCallback(callbackName, funcCallback)
    RegisterRawNuiCallback(callbackName, function(req, nuiCallback)
        if not IsNuiRequestOriginValid(req.headers) then
            debugPrint(("^1Invalid NUI callback origin for %s"):format(callbackName))
            return nuiCallback({
                status = 403,
                body = '{}',
            })
        end

        -- calls the function
        funcCallback(json.decode(req.body), function(data)
            nuiCallback({
                status = 200,
                body = type(data) == 'table' and json.encode(data) or '{}',
            })
        end)
    end)
end

    -- print("------------------------------------")
    local myID = GetPlayerServerId(PlayerId())
    local myPed = PlayerPedId()
    local myCoords = GetEntityCoords(myPed)

    for _, playerData in pairs(players) do
        local pid = playerData[1]
        local pidStr = tostring(playerData[1])
        local localPlayer = LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[pidStr]
        -- Set inbound data
        if localPlayer == nil then
            debugPrint("Playerlist: received detailed info for player "..pidStr.." not present in local playerlist")
            requirePlayerNames = true
            LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[pidStr] = {
                name = "unknown",
                health = playerData[2],
                vType = vTypeMap[tostring(playerData[3])] or "unknown",
                admin = false
            }
        else
            LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[pidStr].health = playerData[2]
            LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[pidStr].vType = vTypeMap[tostring(playerData[3])] or "unknown"
            -- Set the player name if available - used when the playerJoining (txcl:plist:updatePlayer) was missed
            if playerData[6] then
                LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[pidStr].name = playerData[6]
            end
        end

        --Mark as updated
        LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[pidStr].inLastUpdate = true

        -- Getting distance + health for RedM
        -- NOTE: RedM doesn't save ped health data on server, so need to get locally
        if pid == myID then
            LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[pidStr].dist = 0
            if IS_REDM then
                LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[pidStr].health = GetPedHealthPercent(myPed)
            end
        else
            --calc distance (onesync only, 2d only)
            if playerData[4] == nil or playerData[5] == nil then
                LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[pidStr].dist = -1
            else
                local remoteCoords = vector3(playerData[4], playerData[5], myCoords.z)
                LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[pidStr].dist = floor(#(myCoords - remoteCoords))
            end

            --get health locally
            if IS_REDM then
                local remotePlayer = GetPlayerFromServerId(pid)
                if remotePlayer == -1 then
                    LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[pidStr].health = -1
                else
                    local remotePed = GetPlayerPed(remotePlayer)
                    LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[pidStr].health = GetPedHealthPercent(remotePed)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    --Check if player disconnected and the playerDropped (txcl:plist:updatePlayer) was missed
    for playerID, playerData in pairs(LOCAL_PLAYERLIST) do
        if playerData.inLastUpdate == true then
            playerData.inLastUpdate = false
        else
            debugPrint("Playerlist: did not receive detailed info for player "..playerID.." present in local playerlist")
            LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[playerID] = nil
        end
    end

    -- Mark admins
    for _, adminID in pairs(admins) do
        local id = tostring(adminID)
        if LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[id] ~= nil then
            LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[id].admin = true
        end
    end

    -- print("------------------------------------")
    -- print(json.encode(LOCAL_PLAYERLIST, {indent = true}))
    -- print("------------------------------------")
    sendReactPlayerlist()
end)


-- Triggered on player join/leave
-- add/remove specific id to playerlist
RegisterNetEvent('txcl:plist:updatePlayer', function(id, data)
    local pids = tostring(id)
    if data == false then
        debugPrint("^2txcl:plist:updatePlayer: ^3"..id.."^2 disconnected")
        LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[pids] = nil
    else
        debugPrint("^2txcl:plist:updatePlayer: ^3"..id.."^2 connected")
        LOCAL_PLAYERLIST[pids] = {
            name = data,
            health = 0,
            dist = -1,
            vType = "unknown",
            admin = false
        }
    end
    sendReactPlayerlist()
end)


-- Triggered when the "player" tab opens in the menu, and every 5s after that
RegisterSecureNuiCallback('signalPlayersPageOpen', function(_, cb)
    TriggerServerEvent('txsv:req:plist:getDetailed', requirePlayerNames)
    requirePlayerNames = false
    cb({})
end)

local CORE = 'my_core'

local ACCOUNTS = { cash = 'money', bank = 'bank', dirty = 'black_money' }

local function player(source)
  return exports[CORE]:GetPlayer(source)
end

local function plugIn()
  if GetResourceState('fivebot_bridge') ~= 'started' or GetResourceState(CORE) ~= 'started' then return end

  exports.fivebot_bridge:Provide('framework', {
    character = function(source)
      local p = player(source)
      if not p then return nil end
      return { name = p.firstName .. ' ' .. p.lastName, job = p.job.name, grade = p.job.gradeLabel }
    end,
    key = function(source)
      local p = player(source)
      return p and p.citizenId
    end,
    money = function(source)
      local p = player(source)
      if not p then return nil end
      return { cash = p.accounts.money or 0, bank = p.accounts.bank or 0, dirty = p.accounts.black_money or 0 }
    end,
    addMoney = function(source, account, amount)
      return exports[CORE]:AddMoney(source, ACCOUNTS[account], amount) == true
    end,
    removeMoney = function(source, account, amount)
      local p = player(source)
      if not p or (p.accounts[ACCOUNTS[account]] or 0) < amount then return false end
      return exports[CORE]:RemoveMoney(source, ACCOUNTS[account], amount) == true
    end,
    setJob = function(source, job, grade)
      return exports[CORE]:SetJob(source, job, grade) == true
    end,
  })
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(resource)
  if resource == 'fivebot_bridge' or resource == CORE then plugIn() end
end)

plugIn()

-- =============================================
--  This file is for base menu functionality (admin status,
--  visibility, keybinds, focus callbacks's, threads, etc)
-- =============================================

-- Global Variables
-- TODO: they should be upper case
menuIsAccessible = false
isMenuVisible = false
tsLastMenuClose = 0
menuPermissions = {}
lastTpCoords = false;

-- Locals
local noMenuReason = 'unknown reason'
local awaitingReauth = false

--- Logic to displaying the menu auth rejected snackbar
local function displayAuthRejectedError()
  if noMenuReason == 'nui_admin_not_found' then
    sendSnackbarMessage('error', 'nui_menu.misc.menu_not_admin', true)
  else
    sendSnackbarMessage('error', 'nui_menu.misc.menu_auth_failed', true, { reason = noMenuReason })
  end
end

--- Tests for menu accessibility and displays error snackbar if needed
local function checkMenuAccessible()
  if not TX_MENU_ENABLED then
    sendSnackbarMessage('error', 'nui_menu.misc.not_enabled', true)
    return false
  end
  if not menuIsAccessible then
    displayAuthRejectedError()
    return false
  end

  return true
end


-- Register txAdmin command
local function txadmin(_, args)
  if not checkMenuAccessible() then return end

  -- Make visible
  toggleMenuVisibility()

  -- Shortcut to open a specific players profile
  if isMenuVisible and #args >= 1 then
    local targetPlayer = table.concat(args, ' ')
    sendMenuMessage('openPlayerModal', targetPlayer)
  end
end
RegisterCommand('txadmin', txadmin)
RegisterCommand('tx', txadmin)

RegisterCommand('txAdmin:menu:openPlayersPage', function()
  if not checkMenuAccessible() then return end
  sendMenuMessage('setMenuPage', 1)
  toggleMenuVisibility(true)
  SetNuiFocus(true, true)
end)


-- This needs to run even when menu is disabled so the ServerCtx
-- is updated for react, needed by the Warn page
RegisterSecureNuiCallback('reactLoaded', function(_, cb)
  debugPrint("React loaded, requesting ServerCtx.")

  CreateThread(function()
    updateServerCtx()
    while ServerCtx == false do Wait(0) end
    debugPrint("ServerCtx loaded, sending variables.")
    sendMenuMessage('setGameName', GAME_NAME)
    sendMenuMessage('setDebugMode', TX_DEBUG_MODE)
    sendMenuMessage('setServerCtx', ServerCtx)
    sendMenuMessage('setPermissions', menuPermissions)
  end)

  cb({})
end)


-- =============================================
--  The rest of the file will only run if menu is enabled
-- =============================================

-- Prevent running if menu is disabled
if not TX_MENU_ENABLED then return end

-- Checking with server if we are an admin
TriggerServerEvent('txsv:checkIfAdmin')

-- Triggered as callback of txsv:checkIfAdmin
RegisterNetEvent('txcl:setAdmin', function(username, perms, rejectReason)
  if type(perms) == 'table' then
    debugPrint("^2[AUTH] logged in as '" .. username .. "' with perms: " .. json.encode(perms or "nil"))
    menuIsAccessible = true
    menuPermissions = perms
    if IS_FIVEM then
      --NOTE: appending # to the desc so the sorting shows it at the top
      RegisterKeyMapping('txadmin', 'Open Main Page', 'KEYBOARD', '')
      RegisterKeyMapping('txAdmin:menu:openPlayersPage', 'Open Players page', 'KEYBOARD', '')
      RegisterKeyMapping('txAdmin:menu:clearArea', 'Clear Area', 'KEYBOARD', '')
      RegisterKeyMapping('txAdmin:menu:healMyself', 'Heal Yourself', 'KEYBOARD', '')
      RegisterKeyMapping('txAdmin:menu:tpBack', 'Teleport: go Back', 'KEYBOARD', '')
      RegisterKeyMapping('txAdmin:menu:tpToCoords', 'Teleport: to Coords', 'KEYBOARD', '')
      RegisterKeyMapping('txAdmin:menu:tpToWaypoint', 'Teleport: to Waypoint', 'KEYBOARD', '')
      RegisterKeyMapping('txAdmin:menu:noClipToggle', 'Toggle NoClip', 'KEYBOARD', '')
      RegisterKeyMapping('txAdmin:menu:togglePlayerIDs', 'Toggle Player IDs', 'KEYBOARD', '')
      RegisterKeyMapping('txAdmin:menu:boostVehicle', 'Vehicle: Boost', 'KEYBOARD', '')
      RegisterKeyMapping('txAdmin:menu:deleteVehicle', 'Vehicle: Delete', 'KEYBOARD', '')
      RegisterKeyMapping('txAdmin:menu:fixVehicle', 'Vehicle: Fix', 'KEYBOARD', '')
      RegisterKeyMapping('txAdmin:menu:spawnVehicle', 'Vehicle: Spawn', 'KEYBOARD', '')
    end
  else
    noMenuReason = tostring(rejectReason)
    debugPrint("^3[AUTH] rejected (" .. noMenuReason .. ")")
    if awaitingReauth then
      displayAuthRejectedError()
      awaitingReauth = false
    end
    menuIsAccessible = false
    menuPermissions = {}
  end
  sendMenuMessage('setPermissions', menuPermissions)
end)


--[[ Debug Events / Commands ]]
-- Command/event to trigger a authentication attempt
local function retryAuthentication()
  debugPrint("^5[AUTH] Retrying menu authentication.")
  menuIsAccessible = false
  menuPermissions = {}
  sendMenuMessage('setPermissions', menuPermissions)
  TriggerServerEvent('txsv:checkIfAdmin')
end
RegisterNetEvent('txcl:reAuth', retryAuthentication)
RegisterCommand('txAdmin-reauth', function()
  sendSnackbarMessage('info', 'Retrying menu authentication.', false)
  awaitingReauth = true
  retryAuthentication()
end)


-- Register chat suggestions
-- txAdmin starts before the chat resource, so we need to wait a bit
CreateThread(function()
  Wait(1000)
  TriggerEvent(
    'chat:addSuggestion',
    '/tx',
    'Opens the main txAdmin Menu or specific for a player.',
    { { name = "player ID/name", help = "(Optional) Open player modal for specific ID or name." } }
  )
  TriggerEvent(
    'chat:addSuggestion',
    '/txAdmin-reauth',
    'Retries to authenticate the menu NUI.'
  )
end)


-- Will toggle debug logging
RegisterNetEvent('txcl:setDebugMode', function(enabled)
  TX_DEBUG_MODE = enabled
  sendMenuMessage('setDebugMode', TX_DEBUG_MODE)
end)


--[[ NUI Callbacks ]]
-- Triggered whenever we require full focus, cursor and keyboard
RegisterSecureNuiCallback('focusInputs', function(shouldFocus, cb)
  debugPrint('NUI Focus + Keep Input ' .. tostring(shouldFocus))
  -- Will prevent mouse focus on initial menu mount as the useEffect emits there
  if not isMenuVisible then
    return
  end
  SetNuiFocus(true, shouldFocus)
  SetNuiFocusKeepInput(not shouldFocus)
  cb({})
end)


-- When the escape key is pressed in menu
RegisterSecureNuiCallback('closeMenu', function(_, cb)
  isMenuVisible = false
  tsLastMenuClose = GetGameTimer()
  debugPrint('Releasing all NUI Focus')
  SetNuiFocus(false)
  SetNuiFocusKeepInput(false)
  playLibrarySound('enter')
  cb({})
end)


-- Audio play callback
RegisterSecureNuiCallback('playSound', function(sound, cb)
  playLibrarySound(sound)
  cb({})
end)

-- Heals local player
RegisterNetEvent('txcl:heal', function()
  debugPrint('Received heal event, healing to full')
  local ped = PlayerPedId()
  local pos = GetEntityCoords(ped)
  local heading = GetEntityHeading(ped)
  if IsEntityDead(ped) then
    NetworkResurrectLocalPlayer(pos[1], pos[2], pos[3], heading, false, false)
  end
  ResurrectPed(ped)
  SetEntityHealth(ped, GetEntityMaxHealth(ped))
  ClearPedBloodDamage(ped)
  RestorePlayerStamina(PlayerId(), 100.0)
  if IS_REDM then
    Citizen.InvokeNative(0xC6258F41D86676E0, ped, 0, 100) -- SetAttributeCoreValue
    Citizen.InvokeNative(0xC6258F41D86676E0, ped, 1, 100) -- SetAttributeCoreValue
    Citizen.InvokeNative(0xC6258F41D86676E0, ped, 2, 100) -- SetAttributeCoreValue
  end
end)

-- Tell the user he is an admin and that /tx is available
AddEventHandler('playerSpawned', function()
  Wait(15000)
  if menuIsAccessible then
    sendMenuMessage('showMenuHelpInfo', {})
  end
end)

    end,
    add = function(source, item, count)
      return inventory:AddItem(source, item, count) == true
    end,
    remove = function(source, item, count)
      return inventory:RemoveItem(source, item, count) == true
    end,
  })
end

local MENU = 'my_adminmenu'

local function bridge()
  return GetResourceState('fivebot_bridge') == 'started'
end

AddEventHandler(MENU .. ':playerBanned', function(ban)
  if not bridge() then return end
  exports.fivebot_bridge:reportAction({
    kind = 'ban',
    id = ban.id,
    author = ban.adminSource or ban.adminName,
    target = ban.targetSource or { license = ban.license, discord = ban.discord },
    targetName = ban.targetName,
    reason = ban.reason,
    expiresAt = ban.expiresAt,
  })
end)

AddEventHandler(MENU .. ':playerWarned', function(warn)
  if not bridge() then return end
  exports.fivebot_bridge:reportAction({
    kind = 'warn',
    id = warn.id,
    author = warn.adminSource,
    target = warn.targetSource,
    reason = warn.reason,
  })
end)

AddEventHandler(MENU .. ':banLifted', function(ban)
  if not bridge() then return end
  exports.fivebot_bridge:reportAction({ kind = 'revoke', id = ban.id, author = ban.adminSource or ban.adminName })
end)

AddEventHandler(MENU .. ':itemGiven', function(adminSource, targetSource, item, amount)
  if not bridge() then return end
  exports.fivebot_bridge:logStaffActivity(adminSource, { action = 'item', what = item, amount = amount, target = targetSource })
end)

local function plugIn()
  if not bridge() or GetResourceState(MENU) ~= 'started' then return end

  exports.fivebot_bridge:Provide('moderation', {
    revoke = function(action)
      local ok, reason = exports[MENU]:Unban(action.id, action.note)
      if ok then return true end
      return false, reason or 'The ban was not found'
    end,
  })
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(resource)
  if resource == 'fivebot_bridge' or resource == MENU then plugIn() end
end)

plugIn()

-- OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
-- SOFTWARE.

local STORE = 'My Store'
local API = 'https://api.my-store.example/v1'
local API_KEY = GetConvar('my_store_api_key', '')

local function request(method, path, body)
  local pending = promise.new()
  PerformHttpRequest(API .. path, function(status, text)
    local ok, decoded = pcall(json.decode, text or '')
    pending:resolve({ status = status, body = ok and decoded or nil })
  end, method, body and json.encode(body) or '', {
    ['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' .. API_KEY,
    ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json',
  })
  return Citizen.Await(pending)
end

local function toOrder(order)
  return {
    id = order.number,
    status = order.refunded and 'refunded' or (order.paid and 'paid' or 'pending'),
    delivery = order.delivered and 'delivered' or (order.queued and 'waiting' or 'failed'),
    amount = tostring(order.total),
    currency = order.currency,
    at = order.created_at,
    items = order.items,
    buyer = order.customer,
  }
end

local function plugIn()
  if GetResourceState('fivebot_bridge') ~= 'started' or API_KEY == '' then return end

  exports.fivebot_bridge:Provide('payments', {
    label = STORE,
    find = function(query)
      local response = request('POST', '/orders/search', {
        number = query.ref,
        license = query.identifiers.license,
        discord = query.identifiers.discord,
        steam = query.identifiers.steam,
        days = query.days,
      })
      if response.status ~= 200 or type(response.body) ~= 'table' then return {} end
      local orders = {}
      for _, order in ipairs(response.body.orders or {}) do
        orders[#orders + 1] = toOrder(order)
      end
      return orders
    end,
    redeliver = function(order)
      local response = request('POST', '/orders/' .. order.id .. '/redeliver', { note = order.note })
      if response.status == 200 then return true end
      return false, STORE .. ' answered HTTP ' .. tostring(response.status)
    end,
  })
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(resource)
  if resource == 'fivebot_bridge' then plugIn() end
end)

plugIn()

local MENU = 'my_adminmenu'

AddEventHandler('myserver:unban', function(data, done)
  if GetResourceState(MENU) ~= 'started' then
    return done(false, MENU .. ' is not running')
  end
  local license = data.player.identifiers.license
  if not license then
    return done(false, 'No license on this player')
  end
  local ok = exports[MENU]:UnbanByLicense(license, ('Ticket #%s, %s'):format(data.ticket.number, data.staff.name))
  done(ok == true, ok and 'Unbanned' or 'No active ban for this license')
end)

AddEventHandler('myserver:checkban', function(data, done)
  if GetResourceState(MENU) ~= 'started' then
    return done(false, MENU .. ' is not running')
  end
  local ban = exports[MENU]:GetBan(data.player.identifiers.license)
  if not ban then return done(true, 'No active ban') end
  done(true, ('Banned by %s: %s'):format(ban.adminName, ban.reason))
end)

-- Cfx.re Lua runtime, client only: members of the `Citizen` table that only
-- exist on the client (`#ifndef IS_FXSERVER` in LuaScriptRuntime.cpp). The
-- `Citizen` class itself is declared in `shared/citizen.lua`.

---
--- Returns a function that invokes the native `hash` directly, which is
--- faster than `Citizen.InvokeNative` when the same native is called often.
--- The returned function accepts the native arguments and the same marker
--- arguments as `Citizen.InvokeNative`.
---
--- ```lua
--- local getPlayerName = Citizen.GetNative(0x6D0DE6A7B5DA71F8)
--- print(getPlayerName(PlayerId(), Citizen.ResultAsString()))
--- ```
---@param hash integer @The native hash.
---@return function @A function invoking the native.
function Citizen.GetNative(hash) end

---
--- Invokes a native handler obtained from an old version of
--- `Citizen.GetNative`. `Citizen.GetNative` now returns a function that can be
--- called directly.
---@deprecated Call the function returned by Citizen.GetNative directly.
---@param handler function @The native handler.
---@vararg any
---@return any @The native result.
function Citizen.InvokeNative2(handler, ...) end

-- Cfx.re Lua runtime, client only: client to server events, from
-- `scheduler.lua`.

---
--- Triggers the network event `eventName` on the server. The server must have
--- registered it with `RegisterNetEvent`; there, `source` is the server id of
--- this player. Arguments are serialized with msgpack.
---
--- ```lua
--- TriggerServerEvent('myResource:buy', itemName, amount)
--- ```
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/TriggerServerEvent/)
---@param eventName string @The event name.
---@vararg any
function TriggerServerEvent(eventName, ...) end

---
--- Like `TriggerServerEvent`, but sends the payload as a latent event,
--- throttled to `bps` bytes per second, so that large payloads do not block
--- the connection.
---@param eventName string @The event name.
---@param bps integer @Maximum transfer rate, in bytes per second.
---@vararg any
function TriggerLatentServerEvent(eventName, bps, ...) end

-- Cfx.re Lua runtime, client only: NUI helpers from `scheduler.lua`.
-- `RegisterNuiCallback`, `RegisterNuiCallbackType` and `SendNuiMessage` are
-- natives and come from the generated native libraries (the runtime wraps
-- `RegisterNuiCallback` to report errors raised by the callback).

---
--- Registers a NUI callback: `fetch('https://<resource>/<callbackType>', ...)`
--- requests from the resource UI call `callback` with the decoded request body
--- and a function to send the response.
---
--- This is the legacy, event-based variant; the `RegisterNuiCallback` native
--- does the same without going through events.
---
--- ```lua
--- RegisterNUICallback('close', function(data, cb)
---     SetNuiFocus(false, false)
---     cb({ ok = true })
--- end)
--- ```
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/RegisterNUICallback/)
---@param callbackType string @The callback name used in the request URL.
---@param callback fun(data:any, cb:fun(response:any)) @Called with the request body and the response callback.
function RegisterNUICallback(callbackType, callback) end

---
--- Sends `message` to the resource UI. The value is encoded with
--- `json.encode` and received in JavaScript as a `message` event
--- (`window.addEventListener('message', ...)`).
---
--- ```lua
--- SendNUIMessage({ action = 'open', items = items })
--- ```
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/SendNUIMessage/)
---@param message any @The value to send, usually a table.
function SendNUIMessage(message) end

-- Cfx.re Lua runtime, client only: the local player wrapper, from
-- `scheduler.lua`. `StateBag` and `CfxPlayer` are declared in
-- `shared/statebags.lua`.

---
--- The local player, equivalent to `Player(-1)`. Use `LocalPlayer.state` to
--- read the local player state bag; writes from the client are local only
--- unless made with `LocalPlayer.state:set(key, value, true)` and allowed by
--- the server.
---
--- ```lua
--- if LocalPlayer.state.isLoggedIn then
---     print('logged in')
--- end
--- ```
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-manual/networking/state-bags/)
---@type CfxPlayer
LocalPlayer = nil
